g.text: WLD 205 DAY 5 — INSTRUCTOR KEY / DELIVERY GUIDE
Blueprint Recovery II: Weld Symbols + Joint Information
0–8 MIN — JOINT-TYPE RETRIEVAL
Use the five Joint-Type Cards. Students name the member relationship and sketch it.
Key: 1 Butt • 2 Lap • 3 T-joint • 4 Corner • 5 Edge
Correction cue: “Name the joint first. Do not name a weld that the print has not specified.”
Move on once the student can identify the relationship without prompting.
8–20 MIN — AUTHORIZED SYMBOL-SOURCE MODEL
Keep the authorized PCCC/AWS classroom reference visible.
Model the reading order: arrow → reference line → basic symbol → side/location → size/length → tail/notes.
Use one arrow-side example, one other-side example, and one size-information example.
Do not turn the bridge into memorization. The source controls the exact convention.
Whiteboard rule: UNCLEAR OR MISSING = STOP AND CHECK. NEVER INVENT IT.
20–40 MIN — SIX SYMBOL-TO-JOINT CARDS
Card 1: T-joint; student identifies the intersection and states more information is needed before welding.
Card 2: Use authorized reference to identify the below-line classroom example.
Card 3: Use authorized reference to identify the above-line classroom example.
Card 4: The number shown left of the basic symbol is weld-size information.
Card 5: Tail directs the student to the cited approved source. Card 6: Missing size = STOP / CHECK.
40–54 MIN — BRIDGE PRINT B
Students locate BRACKET-B, the vertical/base-plate T-joint, dimensions, and the note WELD PER APPROVED WPS/SWPS.
Use the Print vs. WPS/SWPS worksheet to separate source roles.
Print: geometry, location, dimensions, symbol/notes actually shown.
Approved procedure: assigned procedure conditions actually stated in the approved source.
Never add universal settings or acceptance values to this bridge exercise.
54–60 MIN — SYMBOL EXIT
No coaching during the exit check. Review results by domain: Joint Type • Symbol Navigation • Source Control • Print vs. Procedure.
Remediate only the failed domain using one parallel example, then require an independent recheck.
Do not use bridge work as credential or qualification evidence. WLD 210 controls the paired physical application.
